edges.text: Participation in Mechanics Basic Course and a course in several variable calculus. The latter course may also be taken in parallel.

120 credits in science/engineering including Introduction to Scientific Computing/Programming in Python. Participation in Technical Thermodynamics and Modern Physics. Technical Thermodynamics and Modern Physics can be exchanged for Energy System Physics. Proficiency in Swedish and English equivalent to the general entry requirements for Bachelor's level (first-cycle) studies.

120 credits in science and technology including Modern Physics. Participation in Nuclear Power - Technology and Systems. Proficiency in Swedish and English equivalent to the general entry requirements for Bachelor's level (first-cycle) studies.

120 credits in science/engineering including 30 credits in mathematics and 35 credits in physics. Nuclear Power Technology or 2 credits from Nuclear Power - Technology and 2 credits from Systems or Energy Physics II with Nuclear Energy. Proficiency in Swedish and English equivalent to the general entry requirements for Bachelor's level (first-cycle) studies.

120 credits in science/engineering, including 30 credits in physics and 5 credits programming. Nuclear Physics or Modern Physics is recommended. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Participation in Algebra and Geometry, or Linear Algebra I. Participation in Single Variable Calculus, or Calculus in One Variable. Participation in Scientific Computing I, Introduction to Scientific Programming, or Computer programming. Participation in Several Variable Calculus, or Calculus in Several Variables, or studied simultaneously. Participation in Mechanics Basic Course, or Technical Mechanics, or studied simultaneously.
Single Variable Calculus. Participation in Several Variable Calculus, Mechanics Basic Course/Mechanics and one of the courses Scientific Computing I/Scientific Computing F or Computer Programming I.

150 credits in science/engineering including 30 credits at Master's level. 5 credits in basic mathematical statistics. Participation in Nuclear Power - Technology and Systems, Hydroelectric Power - Technology and Systems, Analysis of Electric Power Systems, Energy Physics II with Nuclear Energy, Nuclear Reactor Physics, or Power System Analysis. These courses may also be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits including courses in computational science I, programming/computational science II, statistics and electrical engineering and at least one of the courses Energy Systems Physics, Technical Thermodynamics, Fluid Mechanics for Energy-Related Applications. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Alternative 1: 120 credits in science and technology, including 5 credits power engineering, 5 credits automatic control, and 5 credits scientific computing. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Alternative 2: 130 credits in science and technology, including 10 credits in Energy Technology at Master's level. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Alternative 3: 120 credits in science and technology, including 15 credits in power engineering. Ability to use computer-based calculation tools, such as MATLAB Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Participation in one of the courses Basic Course in Mathematics, Basic Algebra, Algebra and Vector Geometry, Basic Algebra or Algebra and Geometry. The course can be taken in parallel with one of these courses.
Participation in Single Variable Calculus or Calculus in One Variable. Participation in Linear Algebra I or Algebra and Geometry.

Alternative 1: 3 credits in mathematics. Participation in Single Variable Calculus, Single Variable Calculus M or Calculus in One Variable. Participation in Linear Algebra I or Algebra and Geometry. Alternative 2: 3 credits in mathematics. Participation in Geometry and Analysis I and Geometry and Analysis II.

5 credits in mathematics. Participation in Single Variable Calculus, Calculus II for Engineers or Calculus in One Variable. Participation in Linear Algebra I, Algebra and Geometry, Linear Algebra for Engineers or Algebra and Vector Geometry.
60 credits in science/engineering including Single Variable Calculus, Linear Algebra II and participation in Transform Methods.
120 credits including Automatic Control I. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits including Probability and Statistics, Linear Algebra II, Single Variable Calculus and a course in introductory programming. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
120 credits including Automatic Control I and a course in basic mathematical statistics. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Participation in a course in programming in Python (for example Computer Programming I), or the course can be taken in parallel. Participation in one of the courses Single Variable Calculus, Single Variable Calculus M, Geometry and Calculus and Calculus for Engineers.

60 credits including Algebra and Geometry/Linear Algebra and Geometry I/Linear algebra I. Participation in a programming course in Python (for example Computer Programming I). Participation in one of the courses Introduction to Scientific Computing, Scientific Computing I, or Statistical Machine Learning. Participation in Probability and Statistics or Mathematical Statistics KF. Participation in Linear Algebra II/Linear Algebra for Data Analysis/Geometry and Calculus II.

120 credits in science/engineering. Scientific Computing II or Introduction to Scientific Computing or Scientific Computing, Bridging Course. Several Variable Calculus. Linear Algebra II. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
General entry requirements and Mathematics Further level 1c, or Mathematics 3c/Mathematics D
120 credits in science/engineering including Modern Physics, Quantum Physics or Quantum Physics F. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering, including Electric Power Systems. Participation in a basic course in mechanics, or the course can be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6. Mechanics (1TE304) can be taken in parallel.

120 credits in science/engineering. Technical Thermodynamics. Participation in Automatic Control I, whereof 1 credit should be completed. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering including Multivariable Calculus, Electromagnetism, Automatic Control and a basic course in statistics. Participation in Mechanics Basic Course, or it could be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering including Scientific Computing I, Power Engineering and a basic course in mechanics. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

150 credits in science/engineering, including Electromagnetism, Basic Mechanics and Electrical Power Systems. 10 credits at Master's level. In addition, participation in one of the courses Wind Power: Technology and Systems, Hydroelectric Power: Technology and Systems, Wave Power: Technology and Systems, Analysis of Electric Power Systems or Power System Analysis. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
30 credits in science/engineering. Participation in the courses Single Variable Calculus and Mechanics Basic Course.
30 credits in technology

130 credits, out of 5 credits at Master's level in science/engineering including Scientific Computing I, Electrical Power Engineering, Automatic Control I and one of the following courses: Wind Power - Technology and Systems, Wave Power - Technology and Systems, Hydroelectric Power - Technology and Systems. Hydroelectric Power - Technology and Systems could be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

180 credits in science/engineering including 10 credits at Master's level. Modern Physics, Quantum Physics or Quantum Physics F. Participation in Solar Energy - Technology and Systems or Solar Energy Technologies for Electricity Production (may be taken in parallel). Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering including Automatic Control I. In addition, participation in 10 credits in science/engineering at advanced level. Participation in one of the courses Power Electronics I and Power Electronics. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

120 credits in science/engineering, including basic knowledge in electric circuit theory and electronics. Participation in Transform Methods (spec. Fourier series), or the course can be taken in parallel. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.

Option 1: 120 credits in science/engineering. Introduction to Energy Systems or Energy System Physics. System Analysis with Energy Applications or Systems Analysis and Operations Research. Participation in Power Engineering. Option 2: A Bachelor's degree with 90 credits in electrical engineering. 15 credits within power systems. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
120 credits in science/engineering
